_readme: Contributions that are in main but whose pull request does not carry GitHub's merged badge.
On 0.4.6 release night the pull requests were closed before the release branch merged into
main, so GitHub recorded them as closed. GitHub will not let that be undone. The full
explanation is in discussion #353. These people contributed and the generator would miss
them, so they are listed here by pull request number.
Only the pull request number and the commits are recorded here. The contributor's identity is
read from the GitHub API at generation time, so a login rename or an avatar change follows
automatically and nobody's name can go stale or be typed wrong.
Every commit listed below was verified to be an ancestor of origin/main before it was added.
Adding an entry here credits a person publicly. It is covered by CODEOWNERS for that reason.

landed_without_merged_badge.note: Arabic and RTL support. The files were carried over byte for byte and committed under a maintainer account, so these commits do not even carry their name.
